entries.title: Ezekiel 25:1
segments:
CHAP. XXV. 
 
  A prophesy against the Ammonites, ver. 1-7.   The Moabites, ver. 8-11.   The Edomites, ver. 12-14.   And the Philistines, ver. 15-17.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:3
segments: V. 3. Aha-When thou shouldest have pitied, thou didst proudly insult over my people.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:4
segments: V. 4. The men of the east-The Arabians, associates of Nebuchadnezzar, who recompensed their service, with giving them this country when it was conquered, as it was five years after the desolation of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:5
segments: V. 5. Rabbah-The royal city, called since Philadelphia from the king of Egypt who built it.  The Ammonites-The land they dwelt in.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:7
segments: V. 7. Know-Thus God will bring those that were strangers to him into an acquaintance with him, and it will be a blessed effect of their calamities.  How much better is it, to be poor and know God, than to be rich, and ignorant of him?

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:8
segments: V. 8. Seir-The seed of Esau, the Edomites. Seir was the mountain where they first planted themselves. Is like-Are no more a select people than others.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:9
segments: V. 9. The side-That part of his country which was best fortified. Bethjeshimoth-An ancient city; it was a fortress toward the desert, which watched lest any should make an inroad on the country.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:10
segments: V. 10. With the Ammonites-As I have given Ammon, so I will with them give Moab to the Chaldeans, who will give it to the Arabians.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:13
segments: V. 13. Teman-A country in the southern coast of Edom. Dedan-Adjoining to Edom.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:16
segments: V. 16. The Cherethim-The bowmen, the strength of Philistia. The remnant-Who had escaped the sword of Samuel, David, Hezekiah, and of Psammetichus king of Egypt.
